annotations.text:
Harness dashboard, four surfaces. Direction: mission control with game-day energy.

Every value here is a SAMPLE for layout only. Week 1 data starts with the phase 3 deploy; refine this canvas on or after Mon 09-14 with real numbers.

Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-07-dashboard-surfaces-design.md
PULSE. Job A: is it alive and honest. Daily, 30 s, phone-first. One status word; red only by a named rule. Never shows P&L or CLV.

FLOOR. Job B: what is it doing right now. Game day, 15 s refresh in a game window. Game board with live scores, the funnel with every leak counted, open orders racing the queue, fills, exposure lanes. Never shows CLV or markouts.
STUDY. Job C: is the strategy any good. Monday, an hour. Every cell read from report_cells; the UI never computes a mean. No estimate without n and interval. Current week always PROVISIONAL.

LEARNABLE LAYER (added at the user’s request). Every section opens with plain sentences written server-side from the snapshot; labels are plain first, technical second; dotted terms open a two-line definition; this page explains the pipeline once.

TICKET. The fun parlays: REAL money, $50 a week, placed by hand at DraftKings. The one loud page. Legs as lamps, stamps, a payout that dims as legs fall, and the sharp books' live chance of cashing beside what DraftKings pays as if. Never on a page with paper numbers.

LIGHT MODE. Same layout, same tokens swapped: warm off-white ground, white cards, darker accent for contrast, the light column of the chart palette (validated on white), the ticket back on cream paper. Follows the OS; the moon in the header toggles it.

GATE. The October read. Twelve criteria with stored definitions and history; gate variant beside the pre-registered primary. Criterion names shown here are placeholders until gate_reports.criteria_json exists.
